_comment: Upstream design-pattern tracker for google-research/paper-orchestra (Apache-2.0). ERC adopts design patterns only: no code is copied, because the pipeline needs external LLM/Semantic Scholar API keys and LaTeX, which conflicts with ERC's zero-dependency, keyless install. Adoption of any pattern is reviewed by the researcher and rewritten natively.
name: paper-orchestra
label: PaperOrchestra
policy: design-pattern-only; no code copied (external API keys and LaTeX dependencies conflict with ERC's zero-dependency install)
last_audit_note: Initial baseline after a structural audit of methods/, autoraters/, utils/ and templates/. Files were not read line by line.

candidate_patterns.idea: Outline, literature review, section writing and refinement as separate stages with isolated inputs
candidate_patterns.status: already covered by S8 to S11; review for gaps only

capability_map.label: Staged paper writing: outline, section writing, refinement
Literature search, prioritization and citation integration
Automated paper and literature-review quality rating

explicitly_excluded.reason: External LLM/API keys and runtime environment; ERC stays keyless and zero-dependency
